notes: Fix for the loading screen hang: the supplier payment ledger store was only created on fresh installs (the DB version was never bumped, so existing databases never ran the store-creation upgrade and the Suppliers page locked on the spinner with a NotFoundError). DB_VERSION is now 4, which triggers the upgrade on existing installs and creates the missing supplierPayments store; a strict IndexedDB upgrade smoke test guards against this class of bug going forward.
